'''Corrupted spiders''' are low-level monsters found in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]]. Their counterpart in the [[Gauntlet]] is the [[crystalline spider]]. Up to 3 low-level monsters spawn in a room.
